tools.name: get_catalog
tools.description: Mart402 product catalog: all products, prices, payment config, error codes, rate limits. Free.

tools.name: quote_parse
tools.description: Free quote for PDF parsing: page count, route (text/scan-OCR) and the exact final price, before any payment. Use the returned quote_id with parse_document (on /mcp or /mcp/docs).

tools.name: search_x402_services
tools.description: Search the Market402 verified index of the whole x402 economy by capability (e.g. 'ocr', 'market-data'). Every result is a real, probed resource with a measured 402 Score. Free.

tools.name: get_sample
tools.description: Free recorded sample response for a paid product (from real production runs, marked sample:true) - see the exact response shape before paying anything. Available: document-pipeline, enrich, extract, jp-bonus-net, jp-business-days, jp-company, jp-consumption-tax, jp-crypto-tax, jp-dependent-threshold

tools.name: portrait_precheck
tools.description: FREE analyzability check before paying for portrait_analysis: is a face detectable, is the photo quality good enough (clipping/color cast)? Deterministic, no LLM. 10/hour/IP.

tools.name: operator_history
tools.description: Free 12-week measured score history for any x402 operator from the Market402 index (weekly series, trend, volatility, badge). Check a seller's record before your agent pays an unfamiliar endpoint.
